context: The clinical link is BCR::ABL1-positive CML, not all myeloid cancers or high ABL1 expression. Only the two externally checked cell lines are mapped; other Myeloproliferative Neoplasms entries are not assumed to be CML.

label: MEK inhibition in BRAF V600-mutant melanoma
context: Clinical evidence includes BRAF V600-selected melanoma and BRAF/MEK combinations. Our table lacks mutation status and combination-treatment information; a melanoma-only association is an anatomical proxy, not a replication of that clinical context. Do not generalize this link to all colorectal or pancreatic cancer.

cancer_subtype: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
context: Clinical anchor is cetuximab, an EGFR antibody with treatment-context requirements. Small-molecule EGFR inhibitors in our panel are not equivalent to cetuximab; this is a target-level association check, not validation of an approved use for those small molecules.

label: HER2 targeting in HER2-positive breast cancer
context: Requires HER2-positive disease; the provided cell metadata lacks HER2 status. All-breast analysis is only an anatomical proxy, not proof that HER2-negative cells should respond.

label: Estrogen-receptor blockade/degradation in hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer
context: Requires an appropriate receptor-positive context and antagonist/degrader action. Predicted ESR1 binding does not distinguish agonists from antagonists. The cell table lacks ER status; all-breast association is a proxy only.

label: mTOR inhibition in renal-cell carcinoma
context: Everolimus is a clinical anchor in advanced renal-cell carcinoma with treatment-history requirements. Rapalogs act through FKBP12 complexes; a generic MTOR affinity vote is not a full representation of drug action or treatment context.

label: Statin/HMGCR-associated response in diffuse glioma
context: This is not a novel literature hypothesis or an established glioma treatment. Preclinical simvastatin studies exist, while a secondary analysis of glioblastoma trials found no survival association with statin co-medication. HMGCR target votes do not themselves identify a statin or prove HMGCR-dependent efficacy; curated drug class/action must be shown separately.

sources.title: Wu et al.: Simvastatin in glioma cell proliferation, migration and apoptosis
Happold et al. 2018: No survival association for statin co-medication in pooled glioblastoma trials

label: Glucocorticoid/NR3C1-associated response in pleural mesothelioma
context: Specify glucocorticoids, not all steroids. A 1995 cell-line study included a dexamethasone-responsive mesothelioma line; this is therefore not a novel literature discovery or clinical efficacy claim. NR3C1 votes do not identify agonism. Curated action annotations are separate evidence, and growth effects can depend on cell and treatment context.
